claims.text: I designed a multi-experiment research programme (E0 through E8) around one central question: how retrieval, table reasoning, temporal contradiction handling, verification, calibration, and human oversight combine for reliable financial document intelligence.

claims.limitation: Two datasets; reranker baseline blocked by external asset.
claims.text: On the FinanceBench public sample of real 10-K questions, dense retrieval achieved higher Recall-at-K than sparse and long-context baselines, with company-clustered bootstrap confidence intervals; method preference reversed across datasets.

claims.limitation: GRI-QA quant subset only.
claims.text: Separating deterministic calculation from retrieval answered nearly all of the real environmental-table questions within one percent when the correct table was known; retrieval error, not calculation error, dominated mistakes.

claims.limitation: Three companies; small amended-filing class.
claims.text: On SEC EDGAR XBRL facts, source-time filtering eliminated future information and valid-time filtering eliminated expired evidence; restatement-aware retrieval substantially improved contradiction detection.

claims.limitation: Benchmark of 60 cases; no LLM verifier.
claims.text: A multi-layer deterministic verifier rejected every injected ungrounded number (zero false-pass rate) with scale-normalized matching; presence-based verification is bounded because most financial answers are derived values, not extracted ones.

claims.limitation: FinanceBench only; correctness = top-1 hit.
claims.text: Retrieval confidence separated correct from incorrect predictions with high AUROC; at high supported-answer precision, only a small fraction of cases could be auto-accepted — calibration certifies precision but does not create it.

claims.limitation: Public-data track only; simplified ratio conventions.
claims.text: The evidence-to-decision method generalized to commercial analysis: multiple companies across four domains analyzed from raw SEC XBRL with source-linked margins, FCFF, ROIC, and explicit fact/inference/assumption separation; values matched public financials.

claims.limitation: Six demonstration cases.
claims.text: Replacing the prompt-only honesty score with the evidence pipeline raised citation validity to full coverage and routed most cases to review; the AI/non-AI boundary holds — AI produces attestation, confidence, and review status, never a spread.
